therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: BTK inhibition + SYK inhibition ± CD20-targeted antibody therapy
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: B-cell receptor signaling pathway inhibition and B-cell depletion
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Rate of complete remission/complete remission with incomplete recovery (CR/CRi) at Week 25

results.effect_size: CR/CRi rate: 0% (95% CI: 0-39.3) for dual therapy vs 6.7% (95% CI: 1.2-19.5) for triple therapy
biomarker_changes: MRD negativity achieved in 3.3% of triple therapy patients
Overall response rate 100% for dual therapy and 90% for triple therapy
subgroup_findings: Triple therapy with obinutuzumab showed higher CR/CRi rates than dual therapy
Both arms achieved high overall response rates despite low complete remission rates
safety_signals: 100% of participants experienced treatment-emergent AEs in both arms
Higher SAE rate in triple therapy arm (50.0% vs 16.7%)
Infections were common SAEs including pneumonia, COVID-19 pneumonia, aspergillosis
results.dose_information: Tirabrutinib and Entospletinib administered orally once daily, Obinutuzumab administered intravenously

context.comparator: Tirabrutinib + Entospletinib vs Tirabrutinib + Entospletinib + Obinutuzumab
context.duration: 25 weeks primary assessment, maximum 105.9 weeks treatment duration
